title: replace a historical time-series anomaly endpoint
input: The analyst retains timestamped measurements, sampling intervals and known anomaly labels.
action: Anomaly Detector historically evaluated submitted time-series values for abnormal points or trends. The replacement must preserve input frequency, missing-value policy and accepted alert thresholds.
output: The operations application reviews replacement anomalies against real equipment or business events.
check: Replay seasonal and abnormal series and compare false alarms before replacing the historical API.

title: release a checkout feature flag with scoped configuration access
input: The release owner defines the checkout flag, targeting rules and a rollback value.
action: App Configuration stores the selected keys and feature flags. The application's configuration provider retrieves accepted values; application code evaluates the flag and executes the chosen checkout behavior.
output: The release owner enables the feature for the approved cohort and watches its business acceptance results.
check: Verify refresh timing, cohort targeting, missing-key behavior and rollback without exposing configuration credentials.

title: sign a reviewed desktop installer before distribution
input: The build owner supplies the reviewed installer and its approved signing identity.
action: Artifact Signing signs supported artifacts using the configured certificate profile and access policy. Signing proves the approved publisher association; it does not establish that the installer is free of vulnerabilities.
output: The distribution pipeline publishes the signed installer and clients verify its signature before installation.
check: Verify publisher identity, timestamp and tamper detection on the actual delivered artifact.

title: connect a customer-support bot to a supported channel
input: The customer sends a support message through the configured and permitted bot channel.
action: Bot Service supplies supported bot registration and channel connectivity, forwarding activities to the configured bot endpoint. Bot application code handles the dialogue and calls authorized order-status tools.
output: The bot backend returns its reply through the channel after validating customer access to the retrieved order.
check: Test channel authentication, conversation state, tool denial and escalation to a human support agent.

title: train and deploy a reviewed visual defect classifier
input: The quality engineer supplies labeled normal and defective product images with representative capture conditions.
action: Custom Vision's supported training workflow learns the configured image classification or detection task. The accepted model iteration is published or exported through its supported path for application inference.
output: The inspection application uses the selected model and routes uncertain or defective items to a quality reviewer.
check: Measure defect recall, false rejects and behavior under changed lighting before accepting the iteration.

title: present a reading aid for an approved lesson
input: The learning application submits authorized lesson text and the selected reader configuration.
action: Immersive Reader displays text using supported reading-assistance capabilities such as narration, highlighting and language aids. The application controls lesson selection and issues the permitted launch token.
output: The learner uses the configured reader experience while the learning application retains course ownership and access control.
check: Test supported language, token scope, content access and accessibility using the actual lesson.

title: retrieve product documents for an authorized search query
input: The search backend receives a validated query and the user's permitted product scope.
action: AI Search indexes configured documents and executes supported keyword, vector or hybrid queries. The application configures filters and retrieves results under restricted credentials; index content and access rules govern the available evidence.
output: The application presents permitted product matches and source fields rather than unrestricted index contents.
check: Test index freshness, field exposure, permission filters and relevance with representative customer searches.

title: index training videos for searchable speech and scenes
input: The media owner uploads authorized training videos with language and access requirements.
action: Video Indexer extracts supported video and audio insights such as transcripts and detected scene information. The chosen indexing settings produce searchable metadata; the owner verifies generated insight accuracy.
output: The learning application searches the indexed transcript and links the learner to the relevant video timestamp.
check: Check transcript quality, sensitive-person data, timestamp alignment and access to the original video.

title: serve a governed semantic model for financial reporting
input: The analyst prepares approved warehouse tables and the financial semantic model.
action: Analysis Services hosts the configured tabular semantic model, relationships and calculations. Model processing refreshes its data, and permitted clients query the model under its role-based access settings.
output: The reporting client requests accepted measures and presents the authorized financial view.
check: Reconcile measures, refresh completeness and role filters against known financial reporting cases.

title: validate an application release under browser and load tests
input: The release team supplies the staging endpoint, user journeys and performance acceptance targets.
action: Azure App Testing's selected testing capabilities execute configured browser or load checks against the application. Test clients generate activity; the application backend performs the business operations.
output: The release pipeline uses test results and failures to decide whether the staging build can be promoted.
check: Check functional assertions, peak-load behavior, test data cleanup and safe failure thresholds.
